description: Bandarmology for one or more IDX tickers from the broker summary: for the top 1, 3, 5 and 10 brokers per side, buy value minus sell value as basis points of value traded (`imbalance_bps`), with a `signal` from big_accumulation (>= +1500) through neutral (within +-500) to big_distribution (<= -1500), headlined by `top` (default 5). Reports come strongest accumulation first; tickers that fail are listed under `failures`. A heuristic over end-of-day broker codes: brokers trade for many clients, and `both_sides` lists brokers whose gross figures overstate their direction. `method` names the rules applied. With `investor` foreign or domestic, shares are of that side's own buying (`buy_value`) and selling (`sell_value`); that needs `board` all.

board.description:
Which board's trades to count (default "all"); "regular" leaves out
negotiated block trades.

date.description: One session, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit date, from and to for the latest session with trades.

from.description: First session of a range, YYYY-MM-DD (at most 366 days).

investor.description: Whose trades to count, by investor domicile (default "all").

symbols.description: IDX tickers, e.g. ["BBCA", "BBRI"]; the `.JK` suffix is optional. At most 20.

to.description: Last session of the range, YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

top.description: Tier behind the headline signal: 1, 3, 5 or 10 brokers per side (default 5).

name: analyze_bandar

description: Analyze one IDX ticker: technical signals (trend, RSI, MACD, moving averages) and fundamental growth, valuation, and risk ratings. Analyses that fail are listed under `errors`; the call fails only if every analysis fails.
name: analyze_stock

description: Compare fundamental reports (growth, valuation, risk) across IDX tickers. Tickers that fail are listed under `failures`.

symbols.description: IDX tickers, e.g. ["BBCA", "BBRI"]; the `.JK` suffix is optional. At most 20.

name: compare_stocks

description: Broker summary for one IDX ticker: the top 10 buyers and top 10 sellers by lots over a session or date range, each with lots (1 lot = 100 shares), value and average price in IDR, plus totals. Buyers and sellers are ranked separately and gross, so a broker can appear on both sides. End of day only (IDX hides broker codes during trading); `kind` is the broker's own status (local, foreign, state_owned), not its clients'. With `investor` foreign or domestic, each row is that broker's foreign or domestic clients' trades, `total_value` is null, and `buy_value`/`sell_value` give what that side bought and sold (`sell_value` needs `board` all). `rounded` = true means figures of a million and more carry one decimal of precision.

board.description:
Which board's trades to count (default "all"); "regular" leaves out
negotiated block trades.

date.description: One session, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit date, from and to for the latest session with trades.

from.description: First session of a range, YYYY-MM-DD (at most 366 days).

investor.description: Whose trades to count, by investor domicile (default "all").

to.description: Last session of the range, YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

name: get_broker_summary

description: Company data for one IDX ticker: profile, financial statements, earnings, analyst sentiment, insights, and news. News items carry `relevance`: `company` (about this ticker) first, then `market` (general market news). Sections that fail are listed under `errors`; the call fails only if every section fails.
name: get_company

description: Foreign investors' buying and selling of one IDX ticker, session by session (oldest first), with range totals; end of day. With `source` "ipot" (default): `foreign_buy_value`, `foreign_sell_value` and `foreign_net_value` in IDR across all boards, `value` traded, and `foreign_share_bps` (foreign share of trading); share counts, close and `non_regular_bps` are null, and `rounded` = true means one decimal of precision. With "idx": exact foreign share counts on the regular board, values estimated at the session's average price, the close, `change_bps` and `non_regular_bps`.

days.description: Latest sessions (default 10, at most 60). Omit when giving from/to.

from.description: First session of a range, YYYY-MM-DD (at most 92 days).

source.description:
Where the figures come from (default "ipot"): "ipot" gives foreign buy, sell and net
value across all boards; "idx" gives exact share counts, the close and the non-regular
share, but needs curl-impersonate and may be blocked (HTTP 403).

to.description: Last session of the range, YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

name: get_foreign_flow

description: Every IDX holding (above 1%) of one investor, matched by name.

entity.description: Investor name or part of it, e.g. "DWIMURIA"; the closest match is used.

name: get_investor_holdings

description: Holder changes (new, exited, increased, decreased) between two KSEI release dates, optionally for one ticker. Rows come largest change first, one page at a time: `summary` covers all of them (counts by type, tickers with the most changes), and `next_offset` is the `offset` for the next page, or null after the last.

limit.description: Rows per page (default 200, at most 300); `total` reports the full count.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for the next page: the previous response's `next_offset`.

name: get_ownership_changes

description: OHLCV price history for one IDX ticker.
name: get_price_history

description: Latest quotes (price, change, volume, 52-week range, market cap) for one or more IDX tickers.

symbols.description: IDX tickers, e.g. ["BBCA", "BBRI"]; the `.JK` suffix is optional. At most 20.

name: get_quotes

name: get_shareholders
